inclusions.text: Pickup from your hotel in Cairo
inclusions.source: The day begins in Cairo with a pickup from your hotel, after which the road runs south along the east bank of the Nile toward Minya.

inclusions.text: Transport back to your hotel in Cairo
inclusions.source: After a day immersed in the wonders of Al Menya, relax as we transport you back to your hotel in Cairo.
